sentences.text: Researchers developed a computer model named PM-BGAQAN to classify brain and heart signals into three seizure states: pre-ictal, ictal, and inter-ictal.
The system filters background noise, analyzes patterns across time scales to combine the data, and includes a component that accounts for uncertainty to enhance feature reliability.
After fine-tuning network settings with an optimization algorithm, the model was evaluated on two datasets comprising scalp EEG and wearable EEG with ECG recordings.
The model achieved an overall accuracy of 99.86 percent, while reaching an average accuracy of 98.06 percent when tested on data from individuals not included in the training phase.
The authors suggest this approach is an effective strategy for predicting seizure states from combined brain and heart signals.
